description:
Advances: ancora.gate

Severity: Medium/Low (calibrated). Consolidated findings F21, F39, F40, F41, F43, F44, F45, F46, F47, F48, F63.

Read this framing first. The simplicity reviewer named the pattern underneath most of these: the rewrite characteristic defect is UNFINISHED SUBSTITUTION, not complexity carried over from specled_ex. Ancora.Json, Ancora.TempName, Output.config_diagnostic/1 and the ETS memo were each written, tested, and then never wired in, while the code that needed them hand-rolls its own version alongside. In one case (review/spec_diff.ex:32) the hand-rolled version reproduces the exact VM-local temp-name collision TempName was written to prevent.

F40 — the verdict pass predicate is written twice: Output.passed?/1 at output.ex:282 and Verdict.pass?/3 at verdict.ex:55, same three branches, same literals. One decides the exit code, the other the printed result token. A divergence prints a passing result while exiting non-zero, which is exactly what the ancora.tasks subject exists to prevent. Promote Verdict.pass?/1 to public and delete the copy.
F21 — use TempName.cross_vm_suffix/0 in BaseView.unique_temp/0, and prefer File.mkdir/1 over File.mkdir_p!/1 so a pre-placed symlink errors instead of redirecting the write. The spec_diff.ex:32 site disappears with F41.
F45 — point Config.emit_config/1, both Severity sites and Trailer.warn/2 at Output.config_diagnostic/1, and extend forbidden_writer_test to cover the stderr diagnostic channel.
F47 — route Output.json_payload/1 through Ancora.Json.encode!/1 so the module is the single encoding point its name implies, matching how Ancora.Git is the single spawner. Do NOT delete it; it is published on hexdocs.
F41 — delete SpecDiff.compute/3 and parse_source/1, and FindingsDelta.compute/3 plus the binary clause of classify/3. This changes the function set that ancora.review tagged tests call, so re-run the gate against main afterwards.
F39 — add a status option to Next.build/2 and have Prime.build/2 pass its already-computed status through, so spec.prime stops running the derivation twice.
F43 — drop the unused change_set parameter from derive_sets/7 and its throwaway binding line, and hoist the single Compare.compare/4 call out of the acknowledgment fork so the rule reads as the filter it is.
F44 — change the resolve/3 typespec third argument from a bare map to Derive.resolver_context().
F46 — have Preflight.project_opts/1 always pass lib_paths, including nil, so ProjectInfo stops re-reading the config, and fix the comment that claims it already does.
F48 — correct the Ancora.ModalClass moduledoc, which states something false about the running system, and pin its phrase regexes to a module attribute if it is kept.
F63 — delete the stale L12 stage marker from the published Ancora.Parser moduledoc.

Deliberately NOT taken, the review dropped them: inlining all_findings/11 and extracting Severity.partition/2, both of which restructure the gate central assembly path for readability alone.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged tests under ancora.gate, ancora.tasks, and ancora.review: test/ancora/output_verdict_test.exs and test/ancora/output_test.exs (single pass predicate, json through Ancora.Json), test/ancora/static/forbidden_writer_test.exs extended to the stderr diagnostic channel, test/ancora/base_view_test.exs (TempName suffix, File.mkdir on a pre-placed symlink errors), test/ancora/review_test.exs (deleted callables gone), test/ancora/prime_test.exs and test/ancora/next_test.exs (status passed through, derivation runs once), test/ancora/project_info_test.exs, test/ancora/modal_class_test.exs
- Behaviors to demonstrate: (1) Verdict.pass?/1 is the only pass predicate and Output.passed?/1 is deleted; (2) BaseView.unique_temp/0 uses TempName.cross_vm_suffix/0 and File.mkdir/1; (3) Config.emit_config/1, both Severity sites, and Trailer.warn/2 go through Output.config_diagnostic/1; (4) Output.json_payload/1 encodes through Ancora.Json.encode!/1 and Ancora.Json stays published; (5) SpecDiff.compute/3, parse_source/1, FindingsDelta.compute/3, and the binary classify/3 clause are deleted with the ancora.review spec edited substantively so spec.check against the epic base passes; (6) Next.build/2 takes a status option and Prime.build/2 passes its computed status; (7) derive_sets/7 loses the unused change_set parameter and the single Compare.compare/4 call is hoisted; (8) resolve/3 typespec uses Derive.resolver_context(); (9) Preflight.project_opts/1 always passes lib_paths and the stale comment is fixed; (10) ModalClass moduledoc is true and its regexes live in a module attribute; (11) the L12 stage marker is gone from the Parser moduledoc
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or explicitly named test files, plus mix spec.validate; no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, run-until-green: mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused && mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission
  - Verifier tier: mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission plus tagged and --stale selections only; do NOT run the full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path.
  - Fixture hygiene: one TmpGitRepo per test, no shared temp dirs, async only where the fixture allows.
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable surface. Drift, growth, and shrink clear only through substantive requirement or scenario edits in the same diff, never through a Spec-Ack trailer.
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test.
- proves: one verdict predicate, one JSON encoder, one temp-name source, and no dead review callables.

Allowed touches (this ticket may modify):
- lib/ancora/output.ex, lib/ancora/output/verdict.ex, lib/ancora/base_view.ex, lib/ancora/temp_name.ex, lib/ancora/json.ex
- lib/ancora/config.ex, lib/ancora/severity.ex, lib/ancora/trailer.ex
- lib/ancora/review/spec_diff.ex, lib/ancora/review/findings_delta.ex, lib/ancora/review.ex (call sites of the deleted functions only)
- lib/ancora/next.ex, lib/ancora/prime.ex, lib/ancora/gate.ex (derive_sets and the compare hoist only), lib/ancora/gate/preflight.ex (project_opts only), lib/ancora/project_info.ex
- lib/ancora/derive/resolver.ex (typespec only), lib/ancora/modal_class.ex, lib/ancora/parser.ex (moduledoc only)
- test/ancora/**, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md (acknowledgment edits only: substantive requirement/scenario updates that clear drift/growth/shrink for this ticket's own changes; never weakening a must)
- .spec/specs/ancora.tasks.spec.md (acknowledgment edits only: substantive requirement/scenario updates that clear drift/growth/shrink for this ticket's own changes; never weakening a must)
- .spec/specs/ancora.review.spec.md (acknowledgment edits only: substantive requirement/scenario updates that clear drift/growth/shrink for this ticket's own changes; never weakening a must)

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/mix/tasks/**
- lib/ancora/derive/** beyond the resolver typespec
- lib/ancora/review/html.ex
- priv/**

Out of Scope (intent):
- no inlining of all_findings/11 and no Severity.partition/2 extraction (dropped by the review)
- no new behavior; this ticket only deletes duplicates and wires the helpers that already exist
- no ETS memo deletion or implementation (ancora-xla.9 rules on it)

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission ends result=pass
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
title: Delete the dead paths and finish the half-wired substitutions
